title: Premium Accounting Terms: Due Day, Billing Cadences, Grace and Reinstatement Across the Plan Letters
content:
Premium on a policy under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies falls due on the policy's due day of the first month of the span billed. Each policy carries the cadences at which it may be billed, the calendar days of grace allowed after a due date before the policy lapses for non-payment, the calendar days after a lapse within which reinstatement may still be asked for, and what the policyholder must show to be reinstated.

| Policy | Due day of the month | Billing cadences offered | Grace period, calendar days | Reinstatement window, calendar days | Evidence required to reinstate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan A | 1 | monthly, quarterly, annual | 31 | 60 | full payment of every unpaid premium and a signed statement of continued good health |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan B | 1 | monthly, quarterly, annual | 31 | 60 | full payment of every unpaid premium and a signed statement of continued good health |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan D | 1 | monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual | 31 | 90 | full payment of every unpaid premium and a signed statement of continued good health |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan K | 1 | monthly, quarterly, annual | 31 | 60 | full payment of every unpaid premium and a signed statement of continued good health |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan N | 1 | monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual | 31 | 90 | full payment of every unpaid premium and a signed statement of continued good health |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan G | 1 | monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual | 31 | 90 | full payment of every unpaid premium and a signed statement of continued good health |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement High Deductible Plan G | 1 | monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual | 31 | 90 | full payment of every unpaid premium and a signed statement of continued good health |

### Reading the schedule

Every policy in the product falls due on day 1 of the first month of the span billed and allows 31 calendar days of grace, so neither term turns on the plan letter.

Two terms do turn on it. A semi-annual cadence is offered on Plan D, Plan N, Plan G and High Deductible Plan G, and not on Plan A, Plan B or Plan K, which offer monthly, quarterly and annual only. The reinstatement window is 60 calendar days on Plan A, Plan B and Plan K, and 90 calendar days on the other four.

The evidence required to reinstate is the same on every letter: full payment of every unpaid premium and a signed statement of continued good health.
